units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:2:3">Y. Kidd. III, 63ᵈ</cite> top <he>אנא פ׳ בר פ׳ … ליך אנת פלנית בת פ׳ … מיקמת פ׳ וכ׳</he> I—son of—betroth thee—daughter of—, with the condition that I give thee an estate bearing the name of—, and to marry thee on the day—&c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 4:11:5">Y. Yeb. IV, 6ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ביום פ׳</he> on such and such a day (naming the date).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 21">Gen. R. s. 21</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>לפלמוני</he> <cite ref="Daniel 8:13">Dan. VIII, 13</cite>) <he>לפלניא</he> (some ed. <he>לפְלַנְיָיה</he>) to a certain defined person; Yalk. Dan. 1066.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:5:1">Koh. R. to X, 5</cite> <he>פסוק פ׳ בתר פ׳</he> I recited that certain verse, and then that.

<cite ref="Gittin 69b:10">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite> (in an incantation) <he>פלוני בר פלוניתא</he> thou—, son of—; a. v. fr.—Fem. <cite ref="Q01096"><he>פְּלָנִית</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01096"><he>פְּלָנִיתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01098"><he>פְּלַנְתָּא</he></cite>, (<cite ref="Q01096"><he>פְּלוֹנִיתָא</he></cite>). Y. Keth. VIII, 31ᶜ <he>אין הדא פ׳ תסבי להדין פלוני בעלה וכ׳</he> if that woman—be married to that man—, her betrothed husband, and &c.
